title: nats
description: A NATS connection, and the stream this service publishes to or consumes from.

url.description: The server URL, for example nats://nats:4222.

credentialsFile.description: Path to a credentials file the platform mounts. Unset means no authentication, which is a test configuration.

subject.description: The subject published to, or consumed from.

consumer.description: The durable consumer name. Set on a consumer, unset on a publisher.
